categories.label: Openers
phrases: Hope this message finds you well.
Hope you're having a great week.
Thank you for reaching out.
I wanted to follow up on our conversation.
I hope all is well on your end.

sections.label: Cold outreach / introducing yourself
phrases: I'm [your name], a [year or role] focused on [field].
I came across your work on [topic] through [connection] and wanted to introduce myself briefly.
Would you have 15 minutes in the next few weeks to talk about [topic]?
I'll keep it short and work around your schedule, including a reply by email if a call is hard.

sections.label: Following up without being annoying
phrases: I'm circling back on my note from [date]. A one-line update is plenty.
If now isn't a good time, I'm glad to reconnect later.
Wanted to keep this on your radar without sending another long email.
Happy to make this easy — even a 'not yet' helps me plan.

sections.label: Handling rejection gracefully
phrases: Thank you for letting me know, and for the time you already spent on this.
If you're open to it, I'd value one piece of feedback on my application.
I'd like to stay in touch as I keep learning in [field].
Wishing you and the team well. I hope our paths cross again.

sections.label: Negotiating an offer, deadline, or workload
phrases: Thank you for the offer. Before I accept, I wanted to ask about [ask].
I have a decision deadline on [date] and want to give you a clear answer.
If that number is fixed, could we look at [start date or scope] instead?
I'm excited about the role and glad to talk through what would make [ask] work.

sections.label: Thank-you notes after interviews or coffee chats
phrases: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me about [topic].
I especially appreciated your point about [specific detail].
The conversation made me more interested in [team or role].
Please let me know if I can send anything else as you decide.

categories.label: Acknowledgments
phrases: Thank you for bringing this to our attention.
I appreciate you flagging this.
Thank you for your patience on this matter.
I understand your concern and want to address it properly.
Noted — and thank you for the context.

categories.label: Soft Disagreements / Pushback
phrases: That's an interesting perspective. One thing to consider might be…
I see where you're coming from. My concern would be…
I want to make sure we're aligned before moving forward.
I'd love to explore this further — could we discuss the rationale?
I appreciate the suggestion. I wonder if we could also look at…

categories.label: Buying Time / Deflections
phrases: Let me look into this and get back to you shortly.
I want to make sure I give you a thorough answer on this.
I'll need a moment to review and will respond by [date].
Could I have until [day] to come back to you with a more complete response?

categories.label: Delivering Bad News
phrases: After careful consideration, the decision has been made to…
Unfortunately, we're not in a position to proceed with this at the moment.
This has been a difficult decision, and we want to be as transparent as possible.
While this isn't the outcome we'd hoped for, we believe it's the right path forward.

categories.label: Following Up
phrases: I wanted to circle back on my previous message.
Just following up to see if you had a chance to review this.
I know you're busy — please let me know if you need anything from my end.
No rush, but wanted to keep this on your radar.

categories.label: Closers
phrases: Looking forward to hearing from you.
Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.
Happy to discuss this further at your convenience.
Thanks again for your time and consideration.
I appreciate your continued support on this.

categories.label: Gratitude & Praise
phrases: I really appreciate your help on this.
Thank you for going above and beyond.
Your input has been invaluable.
I wanted to take a moment to recognize the great work on…

categories.label: Requests (without sounding demanding)
phrases: Would it be possible to…?
When you get a chance, could you…?
I'd be grateful if you could…
At your earliest convenience, could you…?

categories.label: Covering Yourself (CYA)
phrases: Just wanted to document this in writing for our records.
To summarize what we discussed…
I want to make sure we're aligned — here's my understanding of the next steps:
Please let me know if I've misunderstood anything.
I'll proceed with this plan unless I hear otherwise by [date].
